info.title: di-scan — DI lifetime scanner for .NET solutions
info.description: di-scan builds any .NET solution with DependencyInjection.Lifetime.Analyzers injected, without changing its project files, and reports Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection lifetime problems with ruleId path:line:column, surrounding source, SARIF, HTML, Markdown, baselines, and CI severity gates.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Where to write the SARIF 2.1.0 report. Default: di-scan.sarif

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration (passed to dotnet build).

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework to build (passed to dotnet build).

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip the implicit restore.

options.name: --rules
options.description: Report only these rules, comma-separated (DI003,DI016).

options.name: --skip-rules
options.description: Leave these rules out, comma-separated.

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Leave out findings in matching files, such as '**/Migrations/**'
or 'tests/**'. Repeat it for more globs. A glob without '/'
matches a file or folder name.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Exit with code 1 when a finding is at least this severe: error,
warning or info. Default: none (exit 0 whatever the scan finds).

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
A SARIF report or text baseline from an earlier scan. Only findings
it does not have are listed and count for --fail-on; the new SARIF
report marks each finding new or unchanged.

options.name: --update-baseline
options.description:
Write the current findings as a text baseline. Implies a successful
scan unless the build or a fix failed.

options.name: --fix
options.description:
Apply the rules' code fixes with dotnet format before scanning.
Edits your source files: commit or stash first, and review the diff.

options.name: --html
options.description: Also write the report as one HTML page, with the code around each finding.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Also write the report as Markdown, for a pull request comment or a wiki.

options.name: --no-github
options.description: In GitHub Actions, skip the job summary and the pull request annotations.

options.name: --findings
options.description: Findings to list under each rule, with the line of code. Default: 3

options.name: --context
options.description: Lines of source shown above and below each finding. Default: 2

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of files to list under "Most affected files". Default: 10

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show the full dotnet build output.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version (the analyzer the tool runs has the same version).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Solution (.sln/.slnx), project, or directory. Default: current directory.
